MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 239, June 22, 1970 ]
CREATING AN EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE TO ACT AS ADVISORY COUNCIL TO THE FAO
SEMINAR ON MEASURES TO ACCELERATE BENEFITS FROM WATER USE AT THE FARM
LEVEL TO BE HELD IN QUEZON CITY IN OCTOBER 1970
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby create an Executive Committee to act as Advisory Council to the FAO Seminar on Measures to
Accelerate Benefits from Water Use at the Farm Level to be held in Quezon City in October 1970 composed
of the following:
The Administration, National Irrigation Administration
The Executive Director, National food and Agriculture Council
The Director,Bureau of Plant Industry
The Commisioner,Agricultural Productivity Commission
The Director,Bureau of Solis
The Administration,Irrigation Service Unit
The Head,Water Resources Department, Bureau of Public Works
The Dean,U.P. College of Agriculture
The President,Central Luzon State University
The Committee may call upon any department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the government,
including government-owned or controlled corporations, for such assistance as it may need and create such
sub-committees as may be necessary to ensure the success of the seminar.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) PONCIANO G. A. MATHAY
Acting Executive Secretary
